one_line: Sangam-age Tamil poet and counsellor moving between chieftain courts and bustling port towns.

appearance.age_look: Appears in her late 30s to early 40s, slender but sturdy from travel, with a calm, grounded posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, softly lined at the eyes, straight nose, arched brows and expressive, sharp eyes; default expression is thoughtful and observant with a faint, knowing half-smile, as if weighing words before speaking.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted in the middle, oiled and drawn back into a low bun at the nape, wrapped in a narrow off-white cloth band like a simple headscarf strip, with a few loose wisps near the temples.
appearance.costume: She wears a simple early-classical Tamil sari-like garment: an unstitched, ankle-length lower drape in deep maroon cotton with a narrow mustard-yellow border, wrapped securely around the waist and pleated in front; over this, a separate upper cloth in muted indigo, diagonally draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the torso, covering the upper body modestly and leaving only the right forearm more free; the fabrics are plain-weave with very fine, subtle stripes near the edges, no heavy ornament; at her waist is a thin plaited rope belt in natural off-white fibre; jewellery is modest—small round gold ear-studs, a single thin gold nose ring on the left nostril, and a simple string of dark bead-like seeds around her neck; she goes barefoot, ankles adorned with a single plain bronze anklet on the right leg, embodying a travelling court poet rather than a heavily adorned noblewoman.
appearance.signature: A slender palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cord and carried in her left hand, with a smooth short wooden stylus tucked into the rope belt at her waist.

ref_desc: Avvaiyar of Tagadur is a warm medium-brown skinned woman in her late 30s with an oval face, black hair in a low bun with an off-white band, wearing a deep maroon lower drape with mustard border, muted indigo upper cloth, simple gold and bead jewellery, barefoot with a bronze anklet, and carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus at her belt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Avvaiyar of Tagadur: a Sangam-age Tamil woman in her late 30s with a warm medium-brown complexion, oval face, expressive sharp eyes and a thoughtful, faintly smiling expression; her thick black hair is parted in the middle, oiled, drawn back into a low bun at the nape and wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth band, with a few soft wisps at the temples. She wears an era-accurate, modest unstitched outfit: an ankle-length deep maroon cotton lower drape with a narrow mustard-yellow border, wrapped and pleated around the waist, and a separate muted indigo upper cloth draped diagonally from the left shoulder across the chest and around the torso, fully covering the upper body while leaving the right forearm freer. A thin off-white rope belt ties at her waist; she has small round gold ear-studs, a thin gold nose ring on the left nostril and a simple dark bead necklace, plus a single plain bronze anklet on her right ankle, and she is barefoot. In her left hand she carries a tied bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts, and a short smooth wooden stylus is tucked into her rope belt. Use a palette of deep maroon, muted indigo, mustard yellow, off-white and warm brown tones, and present her in neutral, three-quarter and rear views with close-up focus on her consistent face, hairstyle, costume details and the palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus.
